member.name: T:Phoenix_GroupERP.GridFill
member.summary: Fast filling of unbound DataGridViews. The classic pattern For i ... : grid.Rows.Add() : grid(0, i).Value = ... : grid(1, i).Value = ... : Next makes the grid re-validate, re-size and re-paint after every single cell, which takes seconds for a few thousand rows. GridFill builds all rows in memory and adds them with ONE Rows.AddRange call while auto-sizing is paused. The grid ends up with exactly the same rows and values.

member.name: T:Phoenix_GroupERP.ThemeManager
member.summary:
Applies the modern look to any form at runtime, without touching the 250+ designer files one by one.
Rules (all colours come from ): * Form / panels : legacy pastel backgrounds -> neutral surface / white cards, dark bands (title bars) -> brand blue with white text. * Labels : inherit the background; red/green/blue meaning is kept. * Inputs : white, flat single border, soft focus highlight; loud "attention" colours become a soft amber highlight. * Buttons : flat; Save/Login/OK/Show... become primary (blue), Delete/Remove become danger (red outline). * DataGridView : flat header, light grid lines, zebra rows, double-buffered for fast scrolling. * Menus / tool strips: . * Legacy fonts (MS Sans Serif, Verdana, Tahoma, Arial...) -> Segoe UI, same size and style so layouts do not move.
Opt-out: set a form's or control's Tag to "NoTheme", or put <add key="UiTheme" value="Classic"/> in app.config.

member.summary:
Small, fast, parameterised data-access helper. Use it for new code instead of building SQL with string concatenation: parameters are safe against SQL injection, let SQL Server re-use query plans (faster) and avoid date-format problems.
